text_as_printed: Table 1. In vitro volumes (in mm3) of 10 largest nuclei (between vertical lines) in ascending auditory system of 53 mammals, with body and brain weights (in gms.) and total of the 10 nuclear volumes (‘total’)

Body weights in parentheses are estimates from Nowak [1991], others weighed at time of dissection. Estimate of body and brain weight of little brown bat courtesy of Dr. Donald Wong, Indiana University.

AVCN = Anteroventral cochlear nucleus; PVCN = posteroventral cochlear nucleus; DCN = dorsal cochlear nucleus; MTB = medial nucleus of the trapezoid body; LSO = lateral superior olive; MSO = medial superior olive; VLL = ventral nucleus of lateral lemniscus; DLL = dorsal nucleus of lateral lemniscus; IC = inferior colliculus; MG = medial geniculate.
